How it works

Three steps to mutual security

🏊
01

Create or join a pool

Form a group with people you trust — friends, family, community. Set contribution minimums and voting rules.

💰
02

Contribute AUDD monthly

Regular deposits build your contribution streak and increase your governance weight. Idle funds stay in a non-custodial vault.

🗳️
03

Vote on emergencies

When a member requests funds, a 5-day vote opens. Weighted approval releases funds automatically — no admin required.

🔒

Non-custodial

Funds live in a program-owned PDA. No admin can unilaterally withdraw — not even the pool creator.

⚖️

Weighted governance

Consistent contributors earn more vote weight. Long-term members' voices are worth more than newcomers.

⚡

Permissionless settlement

Anyone can trigger settlement after the deadline. Liveness never depends on a single operator.
